decision_conditions: <div><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The proposed extensions, by virtue of their design, scale and siting in combination with each other, are considered to dominate the modest sized property and unbalance the symmetry across the host terrace row which will be detrimental to the&nbsp;character and appearance of the host dwelling and overall street scene.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">This is&nbsp;</span>notable given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate. As such, the proposed development is contrary to:<br></div><div><br></div><div><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024);&nbsp; -Policies D1, D4, D5 and HC1 of the London Plan (March 2021)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; -Policies DMD1, DMD4, SP2 and SPP6&nbsp;<span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="">of t</span>he London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan (September 2024);&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;- The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (February 2012)<u style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); background-color: rgb(245, 245, 245);">.</u></p></div>

<div>The scale, siting and design of the proposed development would result in a harmful loss of daylight, overshadowing and an increased sense of overbearing impacts to to no.24 Bainbridge Road. Therefore, the proposal would constitute unneighbourly development which is contrary to:</div><div><br></div><div><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- National Planning Policy Framework&nbsp;</span>National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (December 2024);<o:p></o:p></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- Policy D6 of the London Plan (March 2021);</span><o:p></o:p></p><p><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt;">- Policies DMD1, DMD5 and DMSI3 of&nbsp;</span>The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037 (September 2024); and</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span pt="" sans",="" sans-serif;"="" style="font-size: 10.5pt; line-height: 14.98px;">- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)</span></p></div>
